mechanism_narrative: The level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is continuously inversely related to equity valuation discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as the market consistently prices in monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5%, it triggers immediate equity market risk-on sentiment due to perceived aggressive monetary easing, generating positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The real interest rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) below 1.0% indicates a highly accommodative monetary policy environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as recession risks diminish.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the real rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) and 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), the market anticipates aggressive Federal Reserve rate cuts to stimulate employment, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as the market prices in sustained expansion.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 650.0, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, resulting in positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as the market reacts to improved economic sentiment.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strength in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals a robust housing market and broader consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between the interaction of HOUST and RSAFS and 60-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), the Federal Reserve's rate hikes reduce liquidity and increase borrowing costs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%.
